To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
chicken meat powder is an effective source of protein in the formulation of noodles.
The addition of chicken meat powder in wheat flour increased the protein content in the noodles and also improved the quality characteristics of the product.
the quality of noodles enriched with chicken meat powder can be improved by the addition of 2.5% and 5% of chicken meat powder.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of quality of noodles prepared from chicken meat enriched wheat flour.
the development and evaluation of chicken meat enriched noodles with the aim to improve the nutritional value of the noodles.
the development and quality evaluation of instant noodles enriched with meat powder.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of 10% chicken meat powder to the wheat flour resulted in the development of acceptable noodles which was comparable to the control sample.
the chicken meat powder enriched noodles was found to have good sensory acceptability and the overall acceptability of chicken meat powder enriched noodle was found to be 6.5.
the chicken meat enriched noodles are acceptable in terms of sensory attributes, proximate composition, and functional characteristics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, we have successfully developed a quality chicken meat powder enriched noodles which is highly acceptable to the consumers.
the addition of chicken meat powder in the formulation of noodles was found to be an effective means to improve the nutritional value of the noodles.
the addition of chicken meat powder to wheat flour resulted in the development of a product with enhanced nutritional value, good quality characteristics and high consumer acceptability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of chicken meat powder in wheat noodles increases the nutritional value of wheat noodles and the sensory attributes of noodles were also acceptable.
the addition of chicken meat powder in wheat noodles can enhance the protein content of noodles and can also be used to increase the protein content of wheat flour noodles.
we can produce high-quality noodles with the addition of chicken meat powder and that these noodles have a higher nutritional value.
